passage.text: Kanda has worked as a tour guide in Sukhothai for ten years.
passage.reading: ˈkɑːndə hæz ˈwɜːrkt əz ə ˈtʊr ˌɡaɪd ɪn ˌsuːkoʊˈtaɪ fər ˈtɛn ˈjɪrz.

passage.text: She grew up in a village near the historical park, and she has loved its old temples since she was a child.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈɡruː ˈʌp ɪn ə ˈvɪlɪdʒ ˈnɪr ðə hɪˈstɔːrɪkəl ˈpɑːrk, ənd ʃiː hæz ˈlʌvd ɪts ˈoʊld ˈtɛmpəlz sɪns ʃiː wʌz ə ˈtʃaɪld.

passage.text: "I'm passionate about history," she says. "I want every visitor to understand our heritage."
passage.reading: aɪm ˈpæʃənət əˈbaʊt ˈhɪstəri, ʃiː ˈsɛz. aɪ ˈwɑːnt ˈɛvri ˈvɪzɪtər tu ˌʌndərˈstænd aʊr ˈhɛrɪtɪdʒ.

passage.text: Many tourists arrive with a brochure from their hotel, but Kanda thinks that isn't enough.
passage.reading: ˈmɛni ˈtʊrɪsts əˈraɪv wɪð ə broʊˈʃʊr frəm ðɛr hoʊˈtɛl, bʌt ˈkɑːndə ˈθɪŋks ˈðæt ˈɪzənt ɪˈnʌf.

passage.text: "A brochure gives you names and dates," she explains, "but a guide tells you the history behind the monuments."
passage.reading: ə broʊˈʃʊr ˈɡɪvz juː ˈneɪmz ənd ˈdeɪts, ʃiː ɪkˈspleɪnz, bʌt ə ˈɡaɪd ˈtɛlz juː ðə ˈhɪstəri bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈmɑːnjəmənts.

passage.text: Her favorite monument is Wat Si Chum, a temple with a huge Buddha.
passage.reading: hɜːr ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈmɑːnjəmənt ɪz ˈwɑːt ˈsiː ˈtʃʊm, ə ˈtɛmpəl wɪð ə ˈhjuːdʒ ˈbuːdə.

passage.text: "When visitors see it for the first time, they always go quiet," she says.
passage.reading: ˈwɛn ˈvɪzɪtərz ˈsiː ɪt fər ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈtaɪm, ðeɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ˈɡoʊ ˈkwaɪət, ʃiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: Admission to the park is cheap, so many Thai families visit on weekends.
passage.reading: ədˈmɪʃən tə ðə ˈpɑːrk ɪz ˈtʃiːp, soʊ ˈmɛni ˈtaɪ ˈfæməliz ˈvɪzɪt ɑːn ˈwiːkɛndz.

passage.text: Workers are restoring some of the old buildings, and Kanda often watches them work.
passage.reading: ˈwɜːrkərz ər rɪˈstɔːrɪŋ sʌm əv ði ˈoʊld ˈbɪldɪŋz, ənd ˈkɑːndə ˈɔːfən ˈwɑːtʃɪz ðɛm ˈwɜːrk.

passage.text: "They restore everything carefully, by hand, just like people did seven hundred years ago."
passage.reading: ðeɪ rɪˈstɔːr ˈɛvriθɪŋ ˈkɛrfəli, baɪ ˈhænd, ˈdʒʌst laɪk ˈpiːpəl ˈdɪd ˈsɛvən ˈhʌndrəd ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ.

passage.text: Kanda's advice for visitors? "Rent a bike, start early and take your time."
passage.reading: ˈkɑːndəz ədˈvaɪs fər ˈvɪzɪtərz? ˈrɛnt ə ˈbaɪk, ˈstɑːrt ˈɜːrli ənd ˈteɪk jʊr ˈtaɪm.

passage.text: "This place is seven hundred years old. It's worth more than a quick selfie!"
passage.reading: ðɪs ˈpleɪs ɪz ˈsɛvən ˈhʌndrəd ˈjɪrz ˈoʊld. ɪts ˈwɜːrθ ˈmɔːr ðən ə ˈkwɪk ˈsɛlfi!
